objective: Train, evaluate and conditionally release an experimental coding-repair LoRA; not a general coding, long-task or production readiness certification.

data.construction: Executed, independently graded reference repair episodes from permissively licensed training snapshots; separately label any reused verified local-model trajectories. No invented tool observations, repeated padding or hidden reasoning synthesis.
data.sample_selection: deduplicate exact context+target; reject oversize complete records; task-balanced selection including each admitted task; all retained records if <=512, otherwise round-robin task quotas; seed101 one pass

partitions.development: 15 historical 014 dev tasks, only these scores select candidate
partitions.historical: 24 observed 018 historical tasks, excluded from training and candidate selection
partitions.fresh: 24 constructed defects across 4 previously unused repositories; intended backoff, schedule, cssselect, addict; inspect source and admission only before any model score
partitions.fresh_repository_replacements: Only for rights, dependencies, clean/broken/restored controls or reference exposure, before any model score. Preserve exclusions. No replacement based on model difficulty/performance.

selection.criterion: highest development success; tie uses fewer total generated tokens; next tie lower learning rate
selection.if_no_eligible_candidate: Do not open fresh-test scores; record no selected candidate and no release.

release_gate.weights_release_scope: experimental LoRA adapter plus exact base revision; full merged model only after a separate verified export, never label adapter as complete 27B weights

publication.license_policy: Original code MIT; base and training-source licenses separately preserved. No third-party teacher API outputs.

failure_policy: Fix infrastructure before scoring, preserve failed attempts. After freeze no recipe/data/budget edits. Resume only identical inputs and remaining original 12h deadline; incomplete results are failures, no score-based retry.
limitations: Constructed repository defects, not historical issue benchmark results.
One training seed, 24 fresh tasks clustered in four repositories.
Python/JavaScript scope; no advanced multilingual or long-context certification.
Small supervised pilot; quality improvement is a measured outcome, not promised.
